author: nickyeow

english.text: When you shake hands with somebody, you must look him in the eye.

jyutping: tung4 jan4 dei6 ak1 sau2 go2 zan6，jat1 ding6 jiu3 jau5 ngaan5 san4 zip3 zuk1。
text: 同人哋握手嗰陣，一定要有眼神接觸。

author: nickyeow

english.text: They don't even have the slightest interest.

jyutping: keoi5 dei6 jat1 di1 hing3 ceoi3 dou1 mou5。
text: 佢哋一啲興趣都冇。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I won't leave you when you need me, like he did.

jyutping: ngo5 m4 wui5 hou2 ci5 keoi5 gam2，hai2 nei5 seoi1 jiu3 go2 zan6 lei4 hoi1 nei5。
text: 我唔會好似佢噉，喺你需要嗰陣離開你。

author: nickyeow

english.text: All the furniture in the room was all worn out.

jyutping: gaan3 fong2 leoi5 min6 di1 gaa1 si1 cyun4 bou6 dou1 jung6 dou3 caan4 saai3。
text: 間房裏面啲傢俬全部都用到殘晒。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Don't trample on the grass.

jyutping: m4 hou2 hai2 go3 cou2 dei6 dou6 haang4。
text: 唔好喺個草地度行。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Please drop in at my house on your way home.

jyutping: nei5 faan1 uk1 kei2 go2 zan6 seon6 bin2 lai4 taam3 haa5 ngo5 aa1。
text: 你返屋企嗰陣順便嚟探吓我吖。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I like Japanese food and customs, so it follows that I like living in Japan.

jyutping: ngo5 hou3 zung1 ji3 jat6 bun2 di1 je5 sik6，dou1 hou3 zung1 ji3 jat6 bun2 di1 fung1 zuk6，so2 ji5 ngo5 zi6 jin4 dou1 hou3 zung1 ji3 hai2 jat6 bun2 dou6 zyu6。
text: 我好鍾意日本啲嘢食，都好鍾意日本啲風俗，所以我自然都好鍾意喺日本度住。

author: nickyeow

english.text: It is dangerous to ride a motorbike without a helmet.

jyutping: zaa1 din6 daan1 ce1 m4 daai3 tau4 kwai1 hou2 ngai4 him2 gaa3。
text: 揸電單車唔戴頭盔好危險㗎。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I miss my elementary school teachers.
I miss my elementary teachers very much.

jyutping: ngo5 hou2 gwaa3 zyu6 siu2 hok6 di1 lou5 si1。
text: 我好掛住小學啲老師。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Not only are we all in the same boat, but we are all seasick.

jyutping: ngo5 dei6 m4 daan1 zi2 tung4 zo6 jat1 tiu4 syun4，zung6 go3 go3 dou1 wan4 saai3 syun4 long6 tim1。
text: 我哋唔單止同坐一條船，仲個個都暈晒船浪添。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I showed my ticket to the doorman and went into the theatre.

jyutping: ngo5 bei2 zo2 zoeng1 fei1 go3 hon1 mun4 jyun4 tai2，gan1 zyu6 zau6 zau2 zo2 jap6 gaan1 hei3 jyun2 dou6。
text: 我俾咗張飛個看門員睇，跟住就走咗入間戲院度。

author: nickyeow

english.text: "Do you mind opening the window?" "Not at all."

jyutping: 「nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 bong1 sau2 hoi1 jat1 hoi1 coeng1 aa3？」「gang2 hai6 ho2 ji5 laa1。」
text: 「你可唔可以幫手開一開窗呀？」「梗係可以啦。」

author: nickyeow

english.text: I'll ring you up at seven this evening.

jyutping: ngo5 gam1 maan1 cat1 dim2 daa2 din6 waa2 bei2 nei5 aa1。
text: 我今晚七點打電話俾你吖。

author: nickyeow

english.text: My son is now as tall as I am.

jyutping: ngo5 go3 zai2 ji4 gaa1 tung4 ngo5 jat1 joeng6 gam3 gou1 laa3。
text: 我個仔而家同我一樣咁高喇。

author: fercheung

english.text: This book is mine.

jyutping: nei1 bun2 syu1 hai6 ngo5 ge3。
text: 呢本書係我嘅。

author: kaenif

english.text: Tom screamed.

jyutping: Tom zim1 giu3。
text: Tom尖叫。

author: kaenif

english.text: He has lived here for one week.

jyutping: keoi5 ji5 ging1 hai2 dou6 zyu6 zo2 jat1 go3 lai5 baai3 laa3。
text: 佢已經喺度住咗一個禮拜喇。

author: nickyeow

english.text: He tasted the cheesecake.

jyutping: keoi5 si3 zo2 daam6 zi1 si2 daan6 gou1。
text: 佢試咗啖芝士蛋糕。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Brexit means Brexit.

jyutping: tyut3 au1 zau6 hai6 tyut3 au1。
text: 脫歐就係脫歐。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I think that Australia is one of the best countries in the world.

jyutping: ngo5 gok3 dak1 ou3 zau1 hai6 sai3 gaai3 soeng6 kei4 zung1 jat1 go3 zeoi3 hou2 ge3 gwok3 gaa1。
text: 我覺得澳洲係世界上其中一個最好嘅國家。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Tom said he needed to take a nap.

jyutping: aa3 Tom waa6 keoi5 jiu3 hap6 jat1 zan6。
text: 阿Tom話佢要瞌一陣。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Do you play any instruments other than the piano?

jyutping: nei5 ceoi4 zo2 gong3 kam4 zi1 ngoi6 zung6 jau5 mou5 waan2 dai6 di1 ngok6 hei3 aa3？
text: 你除咗鋼琴之外仲有冇玩第啲樂器呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: Where did you learn French?

jyutping: nei5 hai2 bin1 dou3 hok6 faat3 man4 gaa3？
text: 你喺邊到學法文㗎？

author: nickyeow

english.text: You didn't tell him what his father wrote in that letter.

jyutping: nei5 mou5 waa6 bei2 keoi5 teng1 keoi5 lou5 dau6 hai2 go2 fung1 seon3 dou3 se2 zo2 di1 me1。
text: 你冇話俾佢聽佢老豆喺嗰封信到寫咗啲咩。

author: nickyeow

english.text: This place seems to have relatively low levels of pollution.

jyutping: ni1 go3 dei6 fong1 ge3 hung1 hei3 wu1 jim5 seoi2 ping4 hou2 ci5 m4 hai6 hou2 gou1。
text: 呢個地方嘅空氣污染水平好似唔係好高。

author: aizilan

english.text: I'm so tired!

jyutping: gui6 sei2 laa1！
text: 攰死啦！

author: nickyeow

english.text: I can't sit still.

jyutping: ngo5 co5 m4 ding6。
text: 我坐唔定。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I saw him but once.

jyutping: ngo5 zing6 hai6 gin3 gwo3 keoi5 jat1 ci3 gam3 daai6 baa2。
text: 我淨係見過佢一次咁大把。

author: nickyeow

english.text: It's pretty interesting.

jyutping: dou1 gei2 dak1 ji3 wo3。
text: 都幾得意喎。

author: nickyeow

english.text: This report is still incomplete.

jyutping: ne1 fan6 bou3 gou3 zung6 mei6 se2 jyun4。
text: 呢份報告仲未寫完。

author: nickyeow

english.text: By the way, did you find the umbrella you said you'd lost the other day?

jyutping: waa6 si4 waa6，cin4 gei2 jat6 nei5 mai5 waa6 m4 gin3 zo2 baa2 ze1 ge3，ji4 gaa1 wan2 faan2 mei6 aa3？
text: 話時話，前幾日你咪話唔見咗把遮嘅，而家搵返未呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: I think Tom shares too much personal information online.

jyutping: ngo5 gok3 dak1 aa3 Tom baai2 taai3 do1 go3 jan4 je5 soeng5 mong5 laa3。
text: 我覺得阿Tom擺太多個人嘢上網喇。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Who ate all the cake?

jyutping: bin1 go3 sik6 saai3 di1 daan6 gou1？
text: 邊個食晒啲蛋糕？

author: LeeSooHa

english.text: I'm going back to Malaysia next week.

jyutping: ngo5 haa6 go3 lai5 baai3 faan2 maa5 loi4 sai1 aa3。
text: 我下個禮拜返馬来西亞。

author: thesilhouette

english.text: Tom said that he should have left early.

jyutping: aa3 tong1 waa6 zi6 gei2 jing1 zou2 zau2。
text: 阿湯話自己應早走。

author: thesilhouette

english.text: Are you ready for today's meeting?

jyutping: ting1 ziu1 wui6 ji5 zeon2 bei6 hou2 mei6？
text: 聽朝會議準備好未？

author: thesilhouette

english.text: The man who lives next door to me is a doctor.

jyutping: gaak3 lei4 uk1 go3 sin1 saang1 hai6 ji1 sang1。
text: 隔籬屋個先生係醫生。

author: thesilhouette

english.text: He takes a bath at least three times a week.

jyutping: keoi5 mui5 go3 lai5 baai3 cung1 zeoi3 siu2 saam1 ci3 loeng4。
text: 渠每個禮拜沖最少三次涼。

author: thesilhouette

english.text: A water drop hollows a stone not by force but by falling often.

jyutping: dik6 seoi2 cyun1 sek6，m4 hai6 kaau3 lik6，ji4 hai6 kaau3 noi6。
text: 滴水穿石，唔係靠力，而係靠耐。

english.text: Then Boaz said to Ruth, "Listen, my daughter. Don’t go to glean in another field, and don’t go from here, but stay here close to my maidens. Let your eyes be on the field that they reap, and go after them. Haven't I commanded the young men not to touch you? When you are thirsty, go to the vessels, and drink from that which the young men have drawn."

jyutping: jin4 hau6 bo1 aa3 si1 deoi3 lou6 dak1 gong2：「teng1 haa2，ngo5 go3 neoi2。nei5 m4 hou2 heoi3 ling6 jat1 go3 tin4 je5 dou6 zaak6 je5，jik6 m4 hou2 jau4 ni1 dou6 heoi3，ji4 hai6 lau4 hai2 ni1 dou6，kaau3 gan6 ngo5 di1 siu3 neoi5。nei5 dei6 jiu3 mong6 zyu6 keoi5 dei6 sau1 wok6 ge3 tin4 je5，tung4 maai4 heoi3 zeoi1 keoi5 dei6 laa1。ngo5 m4 hai6 giu3 zo2 di1 nin4 hing1 jan4 m4 hou2 mo2 nei5 dei6 me1？」
text: 然後波阿斯對路得講：「聽吓，我個女。你唔好去另一個田野度摘嘢，亦唔好由呢度去，而係留喺呢度，靠近我啲少女。你哋要望住佢哋收穫嘅田野，同埋 去追佢哋啦。我唔係叫咗啲年輕人唔好摸你哋咩？」

english.text: Fontana says people on the low-calorie diet had hearts that looked 15 years younger compared with the control group that did not curb their appetites. But he says simply cutting calories isn't the formula for a healthier heart. It is paying attention to what you eat. "Calorie restriction does not mean eating half a hamburger, half a pack of French fries and half a glass of one of these sugary beverages."

jyutping: Fontana waa6，tung4 mou5 jik1 zai3 sik6 juk6 ge3 deoi3 ziu3 zou2 soeng1 bei2，dai1 kaa1 lou6 lei5 jam2 sik6 ge3 jan4 ge3 sam1 zong6 tai2 lok6 nin4 hing1 zo2 15 seoi3，daan6 keoi5 waa6 gaan2 daan1 gam2 gaam2 siu2 kaa1 lou6 lei5 m4 hai6 gin6 hong1 sam1 zong6 ge3 gung1 sik1 「kaa1 lou6 lei5 haan6 zai3 m4 doi6 biu2 sik6 bun3 go3 hon3 bou2 baau1、bun3 baau1 syu4 tiu2 tung4 bun3 bui1 ni1 di1 ham4 tong4 jam2 ban2。」
text: Fontana話，同冇抑制食慾嘅對照組相比，低卡路里飲食嘅人嘅心臟睇落年輕咗15歲，但佢話簡單噉減少卡路里唔係健康心臟嘅公式 「卡路里限制唔代表食半個漢堡包、半包薯條同半杯呢啲含糖飲品。」

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: It is the 2nd of March of 2015. One conlanging idea about which I recently ponder is Japanese written in a Hispanic manner, as if it were Spanish, similar in the way the Mexican Amerindian language Classical Nahuatl is written. As an example is "Caquigoori ga suqui da queredomo, ima hua tabemasen": "Although I like shave ice dessert, I am not eating now."

jyutping: ni1 go3 hai6 2015 nin4 3 jyut6 2 hou6。ngo5 zeoi3 gan6 nam2 gan2 ge3 jat1 go3 nam2 faat3 hai6 jat6 man2 hai6 jung6 sai1 baan1 ngaa4 man2 ge3 fong1 sik1 se2，hou2 ci5 hai6 sai1 baan1 ngaa4 man2 gam2，tung4 mak6 sai1 go1 mei5 zau1 jan3 dai6 on1 jan4 ge3 gu2 din2 naap6 ngaa5 dak6 ji5 man4 ge3 se2 zok3 fong1 sik1 soeng1 ci5。lai6 jyu4「Caquigoori ga suqui da queredomo, ima hua tabemasen」：「seoi1 jin4 ngo5 zung1 ji3 tai3 sou1 bing1 tim4 ban2，daan6 ngo5 ji4 gaa1 m4 sik6。」
text: 呢個係2015年3月2號。我最近諗緊嘅一個諗法係日文係用西班牙文嘅方式寫，好似係西班牙文噉，同墨西哥美洲印第安人嘅古典納瓦特爾文嘅寫作方式相似。例如「Caquigoori ga suqui da queredomo, ima hua tabemasen」：「雖然我鍾意剃鬚冰甜品，但我而家唔食。」
